subject: Luminex onboarding — tenant activation & access MAP
messages:
From: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@luminex.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan.torres@catalysttech.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps for tenant setup & API access

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Luminex is excited to get a sandbox tenant and start validating inference latency against our clinical workloads. A couple of asks from our side to make the first week productive: 

- A sandbox tenant (isolated project) with admin console access for 3 engineers (see list below)
- One service API key scoped to embeddings + text-generation for testing; we will rotate after initial integration
- A short mutual action plan (timeline + owners) so Procurement can align on contract handoff

Engineers to invite:
- Priya Gupta (Admin)
- Evan Torres (Integration lead)
- Katie Mills (Security contact)

Can you propose a kickoff window and a checklist we should prepare? Also attaching our internal onboarding requirements spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Platform Engineering
Luminex AI

Attachment: luminos-onboarding-requirements.xlsx (referenced)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@luminex.ai>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan.torres@catalysttech.com>, Katie Mills <katie.mills@catalysttech.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for tenant setup & API access

Hi Priya — great to hear and excited to get you started. Below is a concise plan we typically run for sandbox activation; I kept timelines conservative given procurement + security review. If that looks good I will loop in our implementation squad to seed keys and create the tenant.

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Day 0 (this week): Signed MPA + kickoff meeting scheduled (30–45m) — owners: Luminex procurement / Grace (Redwood)
- Day 1: Sandbox tenant created; 3 user invites and 1 service key seeded (low-privilege) — owners: Redwood infra (Monica)
- Day 2–5: Integration sprint (test generation + embeddings); Redwood to provide example prompt set and stable sample model config — owners: Luminex engineers / Redwood SE (Aditya)
- Day 6–10: Performance validation and recommend config (batching/quantization) — owners: Redwood Research / Luminex

Pre-kickoff checklist for Luminex
- Confirm full legal name for the MPA + billing contact
- Provide list of engineers (emails) and preferred timezone for a kickoff time
- Approve scoped features: embeddings, text-generation (we'll enable streaming if you want)

Proposed kickoff slots (PST):
- Wed Dec 9, 10:00–10:45
- Thu Dec 10, 14:00–14:45

I will prepare the tenant map and seed plan and share it with you before the meeting. Attaching a short checklist and an empty tenant-mapping workbook for your team to fill.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: luminex-tenant-map.xlsx

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@luminex.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: ACTION: Luminex sandbox tenant + API key seed (kickoff tentatively 12/09)

Team —

Luminex (RDW-2026-1642) signed verbal ok to proceed with a sandbox tenant. Priya is hoping for a Wed 12/09 kickoff at 10:00 PST. Please see requested items below and confirm availability:

Requested deliverables (target Day 1):
- Create workspace/project: luminex-sbx-001 (isolated)
- Seed 1 service API key with scopes: embeddings.read, embeddings.write, generation.request (label: luminex-sbx-service-1)
- Invite 3 users as Workspace Admins: priya.gupta@luminex.ai, evan.torres@catalysttech.com, katie.mills@catalysttech.com
- Add role mapping doc to Drive link and attach tenant-mapping workbook (attached to original thread)

Security notes: this is a sandbox. Use ephemeral low-privilege key and mark for rotation after initial integration (Monica, please set TTL = 14 days). Also ensure logging is enabled and audit logs routed to Redact on sensitive tokens.

Jonas — could you validate project naming and isolation policy? Connor — can you schedule the namespace and confirm IP allowlist options if Luminex requests (they mentioned restricted egress)? Aditya — please prepare a short sample prompts file we can share in the kickoff.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@luminex.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 07:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ACTION: Luminex sandbox tenant + API key seed (kickoff tentatively 12/09)

On Wed, Dec 8, 2026 at 08:21 AM Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Luminex (RDW-2026-1642) signed verbal ok to proceed with a sandbox tenant. Priya is hoping for a Wed 12/09 kickoff at 10:00 PST. Please see requested items below and confirm availability:

Thanks Grace — confirming we've provisioned the workspace and seeded the key today. Details: 
- Workspace: luminex-sbx-001 (id: wksp_89b2) — isolated, no shared caches
- Service key: luminex-sbx-service-1 (id: key_7f21) — scopes: embeddings.read, embeddings.write, generation.request; TTL set to 14 days
- Invites sent to: priya.gupta@luminex.ai, evan.torres@catalysttech.com, katie.mills@catalysttech.com (pending acceptance)

Attachments added to Drive: luminex-tenant-map.xlsx (seeded with names & roles). I also opened an internal ticket to enable audit logs for the workspace (TICK-8821).

Jonas — I left the IP allowlist as an optional step until Luminex confirms IP ranges.

Grace — marking this as Day 1 complete. I'll follow up when invites are accepted.

—Monica
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: tenant-provisioning-stub.txt (internal notes)

From: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@luminex.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evan Torres <evan.torres@catalysttech.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Luminex onboarding — tenant activation & access MAP

Hi Grace and team,

Thanks — we accepted the invites and verified the sandbox. The seeded key worked for embeddings and we ran a first pass of latency checks. A couple of quick items before we close Day 1: 

- Could you share the service key fingerprint or a key id we can reference on our side? (we saw key_7f21 but would like the fingerprint for SSO mapping)
- Procurement attached a signed MPA (signed-mpa-luminex.pdf) — please confirm you received it and we can proceed with the production timeline discussion next week.

Kickoff was smooth; appreciate the speedy turnaround.

Best,
Priya
Head of Platform Engineering, Luminex AI

Attachment: signed-mpa-luminex.pdf
